optionMatrix.label: Add compiler-preview commands to monogate
optionMatrix.reason: Lowest install friction, but it blurs the public math/optimization package with an immature compiler preview.
optionMatrix.risk: Users may infer the core monogate package now includes the full Forge compiler.

optionMatrix.label: Create monogate-forge-preview
optionMatrix.reason: Makes the preview explicit, bounded, and separate from both monogate and future Forge Pro.
optionMatrix.risk: Requires separate packaging and quickstart work before any public claim.

optionMatrix.label: Publish reproducible artifacts only
optionMatrix.reason: Safest if packaging takes longer, but less useful as a public compiler preview.
optionMatrix.risk: May feel like documentation rather than a tool.

inputScope: selected .eml fixtures only after clean-room quickstart proves them
requiredChecks: evidence packet with all public claim flags false

releaseGates.requiredEvidence: A minimal package scaffold for monogate-forge-preview with version, README, CLI entrypoint, and tests.
Fresh environment install and exact quickstart commands without sibling private repos.
Generated Python target executes over deterministic sample grids.
Generated JavaScript target executes over deterministic sample grids.
Website/docs copy says preview, selected targets, and blocked claims.
No paid checkout is enabled for compiler claims during preview.
